correctness.rationale: The corrected theorem distinguishes normalized and unnormalized coefficients. A squarefree fibre is a single conjugacy class with S=|GL_n|/product(q^d_i-1); fixed-vector stabilizer transitivity and eigenspace pair counting give N_lambda u=S(q-1)/(q^n-1) on each rational root and a common off-line count. Character orthogonality yields both exact Fourier values and inversion. The old claim that raw coefficients depend only on rational roots is false, witnessed by two squarefree quintics over F_2 with no roots and different S.
